units.title: SG-2 · Remove execution, approve and retry routes from the server
Act: Confirm server.New and adminRoundRoutes hold only round admin routes
Act: Confirm kept route registrations in server.New are untouched
Act: Confirm no execution or worker config or dependency is used by the server package
Verify: Execution, approve and retry routes are absent and admin table is round-only unit tests

tests.name: TestNew_ExecutionRoutesAbsent
tests.title: Execution, approve and retry admin routes are not mounted
tests.scenario: Given a server built from a config with admin.token "tok" and a temporary repo_path, when GET /api/v1/admin/executions, POST /api/v1/admin/executions/x/approve and POST /api/v1/admin/executions/x/retry are each requested with Authorization Bearer tok, then each responds 404 or 405

tests.name: TestAdminRoundRoutes_Table
tests.title: Admin round route table lists exactly five round-only routes
tests.scenario: Given the admin round route table built by adminRoundRoutes, when it is read, then it has five method and pattern pairs in the expected order, and no pattern contains execution

units.title: Verify: Kept contribution, player and round routes unchanged unit tests

tests.name: TestNew_RegistersRoutes
tests.title: Registers the worlds and contribution create routes, with the contribution get route answering unauthorized without a cookie
tests.scenario: Given a server with a temp repo_path, when GET /api/v1/worlds is requested it responds 200; when POST /api/v1/contributions has no cookie it responds 401; when GET /api/v1/contributions/unknown has no cookie it responds 401 'unauthorized'
tests.detail: 3 subtests passed; the contributions/unknown subtest was added in this unit

tests.name: TestNew_PlayerContributionsRoute
tests.title: Serves player contributions with a session and retires the legacy mine path
tests.scenario: Given a player session, when GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions?round_id=ROUND-0000001 is requested with cookies it responds 200 with an empty list; the legacy /api/v1/contributions/mine responds 404; without cookies it responds 401

tests.name: TestNew_CurrentRoundRoute
tests.title: Serves the current round under the world round path and rejects the legacy rounds path
tests.scenario: Given the-boys-room world, when GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/round/current is requested it responds with the current round; /rounds/current is not served; an unknown world returns not found

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundRoutesReturnHandlerStatuses
tests.title: Admin round routes return the handler's own statuses: 200 with id, 404 for unknown round, 400 for malformed body
tests.scenario: Given admin token tok and a temp repo with the-boys-room and ROUND-0000001, when GET existing round, GET unknown round, and POST malformed JSON are requested with the bearer token, then statuses are 200, 404, 400

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken
tests.title: Admin round routes reject requests without a token with 401 and accept the bearer token
tests.scenario: Given admin token tok, when each admin round route is requested without a token it responds 401, and with Bearer tok it is not 401

units.title: Verify: Server package has no execution or worker references and tests stay green unit tests

tests.name: TestServerHasNoExecutionWiring
tests.title: server.go and rounds_adapter.go contain no execution handler or worker wiring
tests.scenario: Given server.go and rounds_adapter.go in the server package, when each file is read, then none contains "execution.", "ExecutionHandler" or "storyforge/worker"

tests.name: TestNoExecutionImports
tests.title: No backend Go source imports the removed internal/execution package
tests.scenario: Given the backend Go sources under ../.., when each .go file is read, then none contains "internal/execution"

tests.name: TestWorkerModuleRemoved
tests.title: The backend/worker module is gone and no Go source imports storyforge/worker
tests.scenario: Given the retired backend/worker module, when stat-ed, then it does not exist; and no backend .go file contains "storyforge/worker"

tests.name: TestExecutionPackageRemoved
tests.title: The internal/execution package directory no longer exists
tests.scenario: Given the retired internal/execution package, when stat-ed from the server package, then it does not exist

tests.name: go test ./internal/server (full package)
tests.title: The full server package test suite stays green
tests.scenario: Given the server package after the execution and worker removal, when its full test suite runs, then it reports ok

units.title: REQ · server.New registers and implements no execution, approve or retry routes
